title: Trello Review (2026)
intro: Trello is evaluated here as a lightweight board / Kanban project tool — Trello is a simple Kanban board tool for lists/cards with Power-Ups and Butler automation. Free for basic boards; Standard $5/user/mo annual; Premium $10; Enterprise ~$17.50 (volume). Ideal when a board is enough — not a full Work OS. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Trello when a simple board is genuinely enough — landscape on Work OS best lists.
verdict: Choose Trello when a simple board is genuinely enough — landscape on Work OS best lists. Compare Asana/ClickUp when you outgrow boards, Jira for eng sprints, and monday for structured Work OS. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

Card comments and boards work for small teams; limited docs depth.
Atlassian + Power-Ups ecosystem is broad for a lightweight tool.
Dashboards only on higher plans; not a reporting platform.
Fine for simple team boards; outgrown by complex programs quickly.
Free + $5 Standard is excellent for the lightweight-board job. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI is not Trello’s centre of gravity.

faq.question: Is Trello a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. Trello is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is Trello priced?
faq.answer: Free; Standard $5, Premium $10 annual; Enterprise ~$17.50. Confirm live.

faq.question: Does Trello have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Trello?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
